name: Rosa + Juliet
summary:
Rosa ✞ Juliet is an upcoming dark and grotesque RPGMaker horror game about exploring both the abandoned and twisted “Sohenwicht University,” and the relationship with your often malicious co-conspirator Juliet.

Inspired by classic RPGMaker horror games like ‘Ib,’ ‘Wadanohara and the Great Blue Sea,’ ‘Mad Father,’ and the more recent ‘Fear&Hunger,’ danger lurks everywhere throughout Sohenwicht University. Escape from monsters, traps and other hazards - with gruesome consequences if you fail.

Traverse parallel universes, turn back time and set up stable time-loops to solve puzzles and duplicate items. Different choices lead to different outcomes across different timelines.
